title: Hold a labour hire licence
what: Provide labour hire services only while holding a labour hire licence.

sources.title: Labour Hire Licensing Act 2020 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 23 (current republication (R6, from 26 December 2025; Labour Hire Licensing Act 2020 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person must not provide labour hire services unless the person holds a labour hire licence
